events.what: Wang, Wang & Zhou give a new equivariant min-max construction of an embedded non-equatorial minimal hypersphere in S^4

judgement.doubts: The S^4 case was settled negatively by Hsiang long before the snapshot; the 2026 paper is a new proof of a known case and settles or bounds nothing new, so it cannot set the status. The problem as a whole (odd n>=9 open per the record) was not resolved before the snapshot, so open_stale does not apply.

corrections.why: other: open_stale requires the problem resolved before 26 Jan 2024, but the record's summary says it remains open for odd n>=9; Hsiang/Tomter results are pre-snapshot partial results on a still-open problem, and the 2026 preprint only reproves the already-settled S^4 case (scope none), so nothing survives and the status is open.
other: no event survives for the status to rest on; the S^4 hypersphere is a new construction of an object known since Hsiang, not a counterexample carried by this row.
